connectors.use_case: Checking a voicemail transcript without dialing in, rerouting calls to a different number during an outage, reviewing last month's billing before it's due.

connectors.name: Voithos AI
connectors.description: Searches recorded and upcoming meetings in a Voithos AI workspace, retrieving discussions, decisions, participants and agendas to summarize takeaways and compile follow-up emails or task lists.
connectors.use_case: Finding what a client agreed to about delivery dates on a recent call, listing recorded meetings with short summaries, checking the agenda for the next scheduled meeting.

connectors.name: Wabot - WhatsApp
connectors.description: Sends WhatsApp template messages and, within the 24-hour customer-care window, session messages through Wabot, creates and updates templates and checks approval, manages contacts and reads chats and replies, asking before sending messages or changing data.
connectors.use_case: Sending an order-shipped template to a customer, waiting for their reply about the delivery slot.

connectors.name: wallsign
connectors.description: Checks digital signage players for status, connectivity, diagnostics and fresh screenshots, reboots or syncs them, and manages channels, playlists, schedules, layouts, tags and bulk settings such as brightness, language, time zone and power-on hours, with a preview before multi-screen changes and publishing only on request.
connectors.use_case: Finding which lobby screens are offline, adding a promo video to the storefront channel playlist, setting power-on hours for every screen tagged cafeteria.

connectors.name: Wames
connectors.description: Reads and replies to Wames conversations across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok and web chat, manages contacts, labels and assignments, schedules WhatsApp messages and creates campaigns, asking for confirmation before anything is sent or changed.
connectors.use_case: Replying to an unanswered Instagram order question, assigning three WhatsApp chats to a sales rep.

connectors.name: Wave AI Note Taker
connectors.description: Searches meetings, calls, and recordings in a Wave account by meaning, returns speaker-attributed transcript text, and reads and updates action items.
connectors.use_case: Finding when a pricing decision changed across months of calls, pulling the exact wording a client used, closing out action items after a review.

connectors.name: Webex for Claude
connectors.description: Lists past and upcoming Webex meetings with attendance status, creates or updates meetings, returns meeting summaries, recordings and transcripts, searches and reads spaces and messages, creates and manages spaces, memberships and webhooks, uploads, shares and downloads files, and browses and searches Vidcast videos with their transcripts and highlights.
connectors.use_case: Summarizing yesterday's product review meeting from its transcript, scheduling a 30-minute team call for Friday at 2pm, finding unread messages in the launch-readiness space.

connectors.name: Webex Meetings
connectors.description: Lists, schedules, updates and deletes Webex meetings, checks meeting status, reads meeting summaries and lists recordings and transcripts.
connectors.use_case: Scheduling a Webex meeting, reading the summary of a past meeting, finding the transcript of a recent call.

connectors.name: Webhuset Mail
connectors.description: Searches and reads email and threads in Webhuset mailboxes, lists folders and saves drafts, without sending, deleting or moving mail.
connectors.use_case: Finding last week's invoice from a supplier, drafting a reply asking for a corrected VAT line.

connectors.name: Weekly Client Update
connectors.description: Turns pasted notes, texts or job logs into a weekly client update organized as done, blocked and next, delivered as a PDF, an email-ready version and a short text message.
connectors.use_case: Converting a contractor's job log into a Friday update for a homeowner, drafting a short text about a delayed permit inspection, producing a PDF to attach to a client email.

connectors.name: Whisperr
connectors.description: Sends a live transcription and translation bot into Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Google Meet calls, checks whether it was admitted and stops it, and lists saved conversations and reads full transcripts with each line's original language and translations.
connectors.use_case: Sending the bot to a 3 pm Zoom to translate Japanese into English, recapping yesterday's meeting with the Madrid team with action items.

connectors.name: WolfSMS
connectors.description: Links an Android phone to WolfSMS, lists and filters incoming text messages and devices, and sends an SMS after approval.
connectors.use_case: Finding the delivery code from a parcel text, replying to a dentist's appointment reminder.

connectors.name: Yeevu
connectors.description: Checks a domain's email deliverability across MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI and blacklists with Yeevu, and explains fixes.
connectors.use_case: Finding why emails from a shop domain land in spam, checking whether its DMARC policy is enforced.

connectors.name: Zetteldesk
connectors.description: Composes DIN 5008 letters from plain text or validates uploaded PDFs, quotes the price, and after confirmation sends them as printed paper letters, including registered mail, posted from Germany to almost any country, with status tracking and balance checks.
connectors.use_case: Sending a gym membership cancellation by registered mail, posting an objection letter to an insurer, checking the prepaid balance before mailing a letter abroad.

connectors.name: Zoho Mail
connectors.description: Searches, reads, organizes and manages Zoho Mail emails, folders and contacts, and sends email on the person's behalf when the required permissions are granted.
connectors.use_case: Finding last week's emails from a supplier about a delayed shipment, drafting a reply.

connectors.name: Zoom Chat for Claude
connectors.description: Searches Zoom Chat channels, direct messages, threads, contacts and files, sends and edits messages, and creates channels and adds members.
connectors.use_case: Catching up on the launch channel since Monday, replying in a thread about the demo date.

connectors.name: Zoom for Claude
connectors.description: Searches Zoom meetings and recordings, reads AI summaries, transcripts, docs, notes and whiteboards, finds when a topic came up, creates docs from markdown, schedules, updates and deletes meetings and manages file collaborators.
connectors.use_case: Meeting recaps, finding key moments in recordings, extracting action items from Zoom calls.
